edges.evidence: Arangetram (film) | Arangetram is a 1973 Tamil-language family drama film directed by K. Balachander, starring Prameela, Sivakumar, S. V. Subbaiah, Kamal Haasan

edges.evidence: Maro Charitra | Maro Charitra (English: "Another History") is a 1978 Telugu-language Indian romantic tragedy film written and directed by K. Balachander.  It stars Kamal Haasan and Saritha in the lead
